findings.title: Unauthenticated Presigned Upload Credential Acquisition
findings.cwe_id: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
findings.description: The application allows anonymous, unauthenticated clients to request valid presigned upload URLs/policies. An attacker can abuse this endpoint to obtain unauthorized cloud storage write credentials.
findings.recommendation: Implement mandatory authentication and authorization checks (e.g. Bearer token or session cookie validation) before generating presigned upload credentials.

findings.title: Presigned Credential Validity Window is Short & Constrained
findings.description: The presigned upload credential expires in 300 seconds, which satisfies the maximum recommended TTL limit of 300 seconds.
findings.recommendation: Maintain short validity windows (<= 300s) on presigned upload tokens.

findings.category: V3: Unrestricted File Types and File Size
findings.title: File Size and MIME Type Constraints Properly Enforced
findings.cwe_id: CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
findings.description: The application correctly rejected dangerous MIME types (HTTP 400) and oversized payloads, enforcing strict storage boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Maintain strict file type whitelisting and size boundaries.

findings.title: Object Storage Keys are Randomized with Collision Prevention
findings.cwe_id: CWE-73: External Control of File Name or Path
findings.description: The backend generates unique, non-colliding storage keys for separate upload requests, preventing unauthorized file overwriting.
findings.recommendation: Maintain unique randomized namespacing for all object keys.

findings.category: V5: File Stealing & Unauthorized Public Read
findings.title: Object Storage Enforces Private Access Controls
findings.cwe_id: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
findings.description: Direct unauthenticated GET requests to the object URL were rejected with HTTP 400. Objects are properly protected against unauthorized public reading.

findings.title: Callback Notifications Strictly Verified with Signature & Storage Checks
findings.cwe_id: CWE-345: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
findings.description: Fabricated callback notification was correctly rejected by backend with HTTP 404. The application requires valid cryptographic signatures and verifies storage object integrity.

response_body.detail: [V6 Prevention] Callback Rejected: Object 'uploads/spoofed_phantom_probe_file.pdf' was not found in storage bucket.

findings.recommendation: Maintain strict HMAC verification and head_object checks on post-upload webhooks.
